reviews.author: SAID DAHBI
reviews.text: I have been going to Uptown shop for over 20 years. William and David not only are great mechanics but wonderful people, very polite, friendly, honesty, clear communication, fair pricing and of course technical expertise. Thanks to the unmatched professionalism and outstanding customer service, I am completely satisfied with my experience over the years.

reviews.author: Mar Dabonvich
reviews.text: Some of the best reliable mechanics in the town. Been taking care all of my cars for years on top of having friends prices and services.

reviews.author: Mark salmond
reviews.text: STAY AWAY FROM HERE THEY ROBBED ME AND KEPT THE PARTS. I NEED A WHEEL BEARING SO I BOUGHT ONE FROM AUTO ZONE AND ASKED THEM TO PUT IT ON. THEY THEN JUST GREASED THE OLD MESSED UP ONE SO MY CAR MADE NO NOISES BUT KEPT MY New PART FOR THEMSELVES I WILL BE GOING THERE TOMORROW WITH MY PART NUMBER AND IF IT DOESN'T MATCH THE PART ON MY CAR. COPS AND LAWYER. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE.

reviews.author: Hector Collazo
reviews.text: This shop is located in the inlet section of Atlantic City run by two brothers that are very knowledgeable with both European and domestic models! I have been bringing my cars here for years. They are very honest and can be counted on giving you very, very reasonable prices! Everyone I sent their way have called me back thanking me for doing so! When you find and have good experiences with repair people like plumbers, electricians, and car mechanics and so forth, they guys should be on your list!

reviews.author: Marcia Blackman
reviews.text: This place deserves all 5 stars. I called this place up the same to get my brakes pad and rotors changed and they were able to squeeze me in. I left my car there and picked it up afterwards. My car was making a squealing sound when I hit brakes and I took it to Nissan twice and they were telling me the tires need changing. Everyone else that I told the situation too and hear the sound said it just have to be the brakes. I know little to nothing about cars and was convinced it was the brakes as well. I changed the 2 front brakes and rotors and was still having the sound. The next day after fixing the 2 front brakes I went back to Uptown Auto Repair and got the 2 back brakes and rotors changed. Now my car feels amazing, no squealing. I am so happy that these 2 brothers were able to accommodate me back to back. The price was unbeatable as well...I bought my parts at an auto zone and I only paid the service fee to get it fixed. Great job guys...I recommend them.

reviews.author: Linda Warden
reviews.text: My sister and I were on vacation in Atlantic City for a week when her car developed an awful sound, She was worried about driving back to Massachusetts without having it looked at. She called Uptown Auto Repair and was told she could come the next morning for them to look at it. Within a few hours it was all fixed with a very minimal cost. We were very pleased with the service we received and the fact that they did not take advantage of us. We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Alberto Salazar
reviews.text: Been coming here for over 15 years, very honest and respectable people. Definitely recommend them. Reasonable prices as well.

reviews.author: Warren Faulkner
reviews.text: I got my car towed to this shop to replace my starter because my car would not start. When my car was ready for pickup, my check engine light was on. Sadly to say, it seem like they broke my knock sensor that left my check engine light on. I went to Midas to see why my check engine light was on and they told me my knock sensor was broken due to Uptown repair shop. I went to Uptown Repair Shop and they told me there's nothing that they can do. I paid $150 to get a new starter in which they broke my knock sensor.

reviews.author: Mo Zaman
reviews.text: I came to this local shop because of a rattling sound that was coming from under the hood along with a "Low Oil Pressure" warning indicator. These two things happened right after I had my oil changed at Walmart Auto in Mays Landing. Willie did a quick diagnostic check, found the problem (faulty oil filter gasket seal) and replaced it along with the oil that was completely drained from my car. He pretty much saved my engine. And he charged an extremely fair price. I've learned my lesson. I'm no longer going to go back to Walmart. Willie will be my main mechanic as long as I'm in South Jersey.

reviews.author: gabriela Vescuso
reviews.text: This service station dz good work but like ALL very busy good service stations, make sure your motor oils are not slightly over filled pass the stick line. Thank you Uptown! U get my thumbs way up! :)

reviews.author: Colly Rush
reviews.text: I have been a customer for about 2 years and I have no complaints. The staff is really nice and reasonable. They never try to get over on you. They're honest, polite & friendly. The prices are reasonable!

reviews.author: John Underwood
reviews.text: My 1999 Ford Explorer would not start. I called Uptown Auto Repair, and had my 1999 Ford Explorer looked at. I was told the truck had a bad water pump. ????? After the repair, I received the vehicle back with the ac compressor missing a bolt, a smashed back window ( I was told someone had attempted to rob nearly all the vehicles in the parking lot), and a dead battery (recharged battery, but does not charge properly--battery light. Not the case prior to service). Now, 3 months later, the truck is overheating. Avoid Uptown Auto.

reviews.author: James Ward
reviews.text: Had a last minute need, a screw in tire. He was able to get it repaired quickly and efficiently at a fair price. Very impressed with the service.

reviews.author: gabriela vescuso
reviews.text: They over filled the motor oil during an oil change. Then they left the filter loose when I asked them to re-do it. They are dishonest & spiteful.

reviews.author: Lucja Dolega
reviews.text: I came here just for the weekend from other state and my car was making noises in the wheel area. It turned out to be small thing. They said they checked it and removed it but it did sound the same. I am not sure if they even checked my car.

reviews.author: Adrienne Williams
reviews.text: Great service. Had work done a few times and I was satisfied. Great prices. I will always gi there for car repair.

reviews.author: Emily Zerangue
reviews.text: I’m in jersey for a work conference and had an issue with my car. It was fixed in less than an hour and car is doing great. Thank y’all!!

reviews.author: C Rush
reviews.text: The brothers and their staff are on point with helping the community and making sure their customers are satisfied and not broke when it comes to getting their vehicle repaired.

reviews.author: Nikki orlando
reviews.text: They did a horrible job. They fixed the problem but created 3 more thats costing me ALOT MORE MONEY. Dont go there save the aggravation.

reviews.author: its me
reviews.text: Pulled in without appointment. The mechanic came straight out and fixed the undercarriage. We were in and out in less than 10 minutes. Thanks for your such service!
